needed.evidence: footway is less than 1m and partly blocked by barriers and obstacles
needed.suggestion: Widen the narrow footway on the right side to at least 1m and remove obstructions to create a clear, continuous pedestrian pathway.

needed.evidence: red and white barriers and cones obstructing movement on footway
needed.suggestion: Remove the red and white barriers and cones blocking the right-side footway to allow safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: uneven sections and trip hazards on the narrow footpath
needed.suggestion: Repair the uneven sections of the footway on the right side to eliminate trip hazards and ensure pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: crossing marked but poor visibility and drivers not stopping
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised crossing with a refuge island to slow traffic and ensure drivers stop for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the pedestrian crossing
needed.suggestion: Add dropped kerbs on both sides of the crossing to facilitate safe access for pedestrians.
